label: ThinkSystem SR650 V2 2U rack server
description: 2U two-socket rack server whose LOM is an OCP-format 2-port 1GbE adapter, supplemented by a dedicated 1GbE XClarity Controller port. Up to eight PCIe 4.0 slots provide room for 10/25GbE stand-up cards.
notes: Onboard-equivalent: 2x 1GbE LOM adapter seated in the OCP 3.0 slot (Lenovo calls this the LOM). 10/25GbE comes from a different OCP 3.0 adapter or a PCIe 4.0 card - not onboard. Dedicated 1GbE XCC port.
